# Apartmani Elegance Tuzla

> Modern, short-stay apartment rental in Tuzla, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Located at Donji Mosnik 7, near Panonska Lake (Panonska jezera), the city's main tourist attraction. Four apartment types ranging from one-bedroom to deluxe 80m². Highly rated on Booking.com and Airbnb.

## Apartment inventory

- [Deluxe apartman 80m²](https://apartmanielegance.ba/deluxe-apartman.html): The largest unit, over 80 square meters, modern furnishing, suitable for parents with children, couples seeking premium comfort, or business travelers needing space to work.
- [Dvosoban apartman](https://apartmanielegance.ba/dvosoban-apartman.html): One-bedroom apartment with separate living area, fully equipped kitchen, free Wi-Fi and parking. Ideal for couples and short stays.
- [Dvosoban apartman s dnevnim boravkom](https://apartmanielegance.ba/dvosoban-apartman-sa-dnevnim-boravkom.html): One-bedroom apartment with a separate living room. Best for longer stays, families, and business travelers.
- [Trosoban apartman](https://apartmanielegance.ba/trosoban-apartman.html): Two-bedroom apartment, accommodates up to 6 guests, full kitchen and living room. Best for families and small groups.

## Booking

- [Direct reservation form](https://apartmanielegance.ba/rezervacija.html) — fastest confirmation, best rate, no booking-platform commission.
- Also bookable through Booking.com and Airbnb.

## Location

Apartmani Elegance is in the Donji Mosnik neighborhood of Tuzla, walking distance from Panonska jezera (Tuzla's salt lakes — the main tourist draw and one of only two inland salt lakes in Europe). Approximately 10 minutes by car to Tuzla city centre. Tuzla International Airport is approximately 8 kilometers away.
